note: Fenced Badlands campground on the Little Missouri National Grassland (Medora RD), reached by about 16 miles of grassland roads from I-94 Exit 10 past Camels Hump Lake; the roads can be impassable when wet. A turnaround at the back helps larger rigs. Trail access to the Maah Daah Hey and Buffalo Gap trails; pack in, pack out. --Claude
summary: FS page read (updated 2026-08-04): 10 FCFS sites for tents/trailers/RVs, $10, year-round with limited services off-season, seasonal well, vault toilet, 14-day limit, Senior/Access 50%. Groups now manual. HORSE RULE: marketed to horseback riders with no separate horse area -> drop candidate for the reviewer.
flags: HORSES - DROP CANDIDATE under AWH's 2026-11-12 rule: the FS page markets the campground to riders ('It's an ideal spot for campers, hikers, bikers, and horseback riders') and lists a 'Horse Riding and Camping' opportunity whose only text is the grassland boilerplate 'Saddle or pack animals are allowed in recreation sites only where authorized by posted instructions. Hitching, tethering, or hobbling a horse that causes damage to live trees, soil, or water is prohibited.' It names no separate horse loop or horse camp and does not say horses are kept out of the general sites; the 10 sites are one set 'suitable for tents, trailers, and RVs'. The stored note said 'Hitching rails for horses but general drive-in sites too' (sweep text, source not re-found). The FS photo gallery shows a buck-and-rail perimeter fence, a picnic table/fire ring site, the kiosk, the hand pump and the toilet, with no hitch rails or corrals in frame; 0.33 m/px imagery cannot resolve hitch rails. Not separated -> reviewer decides; the posted kiosk rules (unread) would settle where horses may go.

ROAD: the page gives directions only (I-94 Exit 10, then about 16 miles on county and Forest Service roads ending on FS Road 726) and no surface or 4WD warning. The DPG alerts close NFSR 735A-9 (to 2026-12-31) and NFSR 747/7471 (since 2024) on the Medora RD; neither is named in the Wannagan directions and the Wannagan page carries no closure notice. Grades not measured.
FIT: 'suitable for tents, trailers, and RVs', 'ample parking space', and 'a convenient turnabout aids larger vehicles'; no length limit stated.

PIN: stored 47.0557,-103.5876 is at the kiosk/toilet in the middle of the campground road (Google 47.055184,-103.587853, ~60 m). The FS lat/long 47.05306,-103.58778 is ~290 m south, toward the day-use lot 'one-quarter mile south of the camp': keep the stored pin.
OHV: trails are non-motorized; 'OHV use within established campgrounds is limited to entering and exiting the site using designated roads'. Not an OHV camp.
PHONE 701-227-7800 and WEBSITE https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/dpg/recreation/wannagan-campground confirmed. No recreation.gov listing (FCFS stands).
